name: Lilim
source:
Lilim is Hakuou and Menou's neighbour, when the two take residence in the village temporarily. She seems to take care of Menou to an almost nosy degree. However, Lilim has an unpleasant background that is hidden from them...

[SPOILER]Lilim is the current leader of the cult-like Golden Bees religious organisation, which was founded by her father (the man who cursed Hakuou). Her goal is to successfully breed a bee and a human to create a being which will be powerful. However, her attempts have failed, and produced many retarded offspring that act as her minions.[/SPOILER]

[Based on the tanslation of the official website profile.]
translation:
莉莉姆是白凰和梅诺暂时住在村子里时的邻居。她照顾梅诺，几乎到了爱管闲事的程度。然而，她还有一段对两人隐瞒的不快背景……

[spoiler]莉莉姆是邪教组织“黄金蜜蜂”现任首领。该组织由诅咒白凰的父亲创立。她的目标是让蜜蜂与人类成功繁殖，创造出强大的生物。然而，她的尝试都失败了，只制造出许多智力低下、听命于她的后代。[/spoiler]

[根据官方网站人物简介的译文整理。]
